SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count, CAST(COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share_of_all_telescopes
FROM observatories AS o
LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
GROUP BY o.observstation
ORDER BY share_of_all_telescopes DESC
LIMIT 10;
